description: The line plot illustrates the accuracy of different models as a function of the number of demonstrations, with the x-axis labeled "#Demonstrations" ranging from 0 to 1500 in increments of 250, and the y-axis labeled "Accuracy" ranging from 45 to 55. The plot compares four models: Squared Exponential, T5h, ELL, and LLAMA-2-chat-7B. The Squared Exponential model, represented by a solid black line with circular markers, starts at an accuracy of approximately 52.5 and increases to around 55.5, maintaining a high accuracy across all demonstration counts. The T5h model, shown with a solid blue line and circular markers, begins at about 51.5 and remains relatively stable, ending slightly above 51. The ELL model, depicted with a solid purple line and circular markers, starts at approximately 48.5 and stays nearly constant, ending just above 48.5. The LLAMA-2-chat-7B model, represented by a dashed pink line with circular markers, starts at around 48.5 and remains flat, ending slightly above 48.5. The legend is positioned in the upper right corner, and a horizontal dashed pink line at 48.5 is visible across the plot, likely indicating a baseline or threshold.
